Title: Academic Speaking B1 course
NewsSummary: ELE_net is currently offering the Academic Speaking course at two levels (B1 and B2 according to the CEFR level).
NewsContent:
ELE_net is currently offering the Academic Speaking course at two levels (B1 and B2 according to the CEFR level).

The Academic Speaking B1 course focuses on developing learners' speaking skills in using English for Academic Purposes. The main aim of the course is to provide course participants with the language and skills needed to participate with greater confidence in academic classes and discussions. The course followed a blended approach. This means that there is face-to-face classroom teaching in addition to an integrated online component. The participants are expected to commit to studying four hours (2 hours face-to-face and 2 hours online learning) a week for eight weeks.

The participants found the Academic Speaking B1 course relevant and useful to their English language needs. The interaction in the class was good where the participants responded well during class discussions. Please see below what our two participants have to say about the course.

"I am thankful to ELE_net and the team to support us at every step possible. The Academic Speaking B1 course was fruitful for me as it helped me to enhance my speaking skills which boosted my confidence. This will definitely assist me to grow in life. The feedback that we received was always on time and was very motivating for us. I am eager to learn more and develop my English language skills. For this, I am planning to take another course that is one level higher than the B1 (i.e. B2). I hope in future, ELE_net offers similar courses like the Academic Speaking B1."

Saman Barkat

"I highly appreciate the initiative that ELE_net has taken to help students in enhancing their skills of English like writing, speaking, reading and listening. I found the Academic Speaking B1 course very fruitful in a way that it really helped me a lot in enhancing my English skills and one of the purposes of choosing this course was to enhance my speaking skills. As with the developing world English is becoming more important and influential in one's academic career. In addition, this course not only helped me in improving my speaking skills but it also helped me in developing the confidence in expressing my ideas."

Faiza Jabeen
